positive_controls: Exact composed schema across imported source files: recognized initialize surface, correct source identity, branch/path/bare fields retained.

Vulnerable operation yields source-matched SENT-002; replace operation with promisify(execFile)("git", ["init","-b",args.branch,"/tmp/unit"]) for supported shell negative; literal exec command for supported negative.
Exercise same schema-bearing entry with existing SENT-012 path, SENT-014 option, SENT-015 URL and SENT-016 credential fixture sinks; retain their rule-specific outcomes.
Right-hand field replacement preserves new default/type and leaves original Base fields/defaults unchanged.
Three- and four-argument legacy metadata layouts and existing registerTool layouts preserve established outputs.
negative_controls: Counterfeit local z/object/describe/extend functions and rebound imported namespace do not gain new support.
Unknown computed or spread extension fields and unknown schema-valued fields do not gain new support.
Unknown/nonliteral describe argument or transform/refine/merge chain stays unresolved.
Direct and alias mutation/escape of base schema, extension map, shape or member schema invalidates new proof; Object.defineProperty, replacement methods and prototype mutation included.
Missing/extra arguments and annotation-only legacy overloads remain rejected.
Depth/deadline interruption and real recursion remain bounded; no new target execution.
required_before_after: Retain the currently failing composed-schema discovery check before correction; no advisory corpus scan during development.
interfaces: Canonical Finding/report/schema interfaces and existing rule meanings unchanged; no source-metadata fabrication.
